language.description: BCP-47 language tag the narration is written in, for example es-AR or en-US.

captionsStyle.description: Caption style applied to every scene that does not override it.

musicTags.description: Mood tags for the music bed of the whole video.

name.description: Short name used to refer to the character across scenes.

visualDescription.description: Self-contained physical description repeated in every visual prompt so the character stays consistent across separately generated shots.

characters.description: Every recurring character shown in the video.

narration.description: Spoken voice-over text for this scene, in the storyboard language.

visualPrompt.description: Prompt the user pastes into an external image or video generator. Self-contained: it repeats the description of every character it shows.

visualSource.description: upload: the user brings generated footage. asset: an existing catalog asset is reused. remotion-scene: no footage is needed and remotionScene must be filled.

assetId.description: Required when visualSource is asset. Id of the catalog asset to reuse.

kind.description: Which native Remotion scene renders this beat when no generated footage is used.

title.description: Required for kind=title. Headline shown on screen.

subtitle.description: Optional second line, only for kind=title.

text.description: Required for kind=text. Body copy shown on screen.

code.description: Required for kind=code. Source snippet shown on screen.

codeLanguage.description: Required for kind=code. Language name used for highlighting, lowercase.

assetId.description: Optional catalog asset id for kind=image-kenburns.

zoomFrom.description: Required for kind=image-kenburns. Starting zoom factor, 1 means no zoom.

zoomTo.description: Required for kind=image-kenburns. Ending zoom factor, 1 means no zoom.

estimatedDurationMs.description: Rough duration of the scene in milliseconds. The real duration is later taken from the voice track.

captionsStyle.description: Overrides the storyboard caption style for this scene only.

musicTags.description: Mood tags used to pick a music bed, lowercase english words.

sfxTags.description: Sound effect tags for this scene, lowercase english words.
